topics.titleEn: How to Build a Browser Extension in 2026

topics.brief: Question-driven build guide. topics.titleTr: Olay Güdümlü Mimari: Desenler ve Tuzaklar

topics.angle: deep-dive + choose the right event pattern and avoid the traps
topics.brief: Deep dive on event-driven design. Sections: pub/sub vs event streaming vs queues; event notification vs event-carried state vs event sourcing; ordering, idempotency and the exactly-once myth; event schema and versioning; CQRS boundaries; when NOT to go event-driven. Verify: 'exactly-once' is effectively at-least-once plus idempotency, and the outbox pattern's role. Sources: Kafka/streaming platform docs; Martin Fowler's event-pattern writeups. End with a decision guide. Distinct from transactional-outbox-pattern, which is a single tactic.

topics.titleEn: Error Handling Patterns That Scale

Verify: structured-logging and correlation-ID best practices. Sources: language error-handling guides; SRE/observability writeups. End with an error-handling checklist and anti-patterns. Distinct from retries-backoff-circuit-breakers.

topics.titleEn: Concurrency Bugs and How to Avoid Them
topics.angle: mistakes + spot the races and deadlocks before they ship
topics.brief: Contrarian mistakes post: most 'async' code is subtly wrong. Sections: race conditions and data races; deadlocks and livelocks; shared mutable state; atomicity vs visibility; async/await footguns (unawaited promises, missing cancellation); when to reach for locks vs message passing vs immutability; testing concurrent code. Verify: language memory-model notes and common footguns across Go/Rust/JS. Sources: Go, Rust and JS concurrency docs. End with a review checklist for concurrent code. Distinct from idempotency and system-design posts.
